description: Start a reindex to a new embedding geometry. The target is named on the command, never read from config. Reads and writes continue against the active profile while the new space fills; the swap is atomic. Operator-only.

provider.description: The target embedding provider, for example 'ollama' or 'openai'.

dimensions.description: The target vector dimension, between 1 and the halfvec storage ceiling of 4000. Resolved from the model when omitted.

base_url.description: The target endpoint. The provider's default when omitted.

dry_run.description: When true, resolve the target, validate its credential, and return the item and tag counts without creating a run.
